scenes.label: 03 · Rung one: screening a billion molecules
04 · Rung two: from atoms to a cell
05 · How we tried not to fool ourselves

sentences.cap: Physiological outcomes come from molecules interacting.

chunks.text: Physiological outcomes come from molecules interacting.

sentences.cap: Those interactions change function, and function is driven by changes in shape and structure.

chunks.text: Those interactions change function, and function is driven by changes in shape and structure.

sentences.cap: Pharmacology is what drugs do to that whole system.

chunks.text: Pharmacology is what drugs do to that whole system.

sentences.cap: So how far can a chain of surrogates take us?

chunks.text: So how far can a chain of surrogates take us?

sentences.cap: Biology has a ladder of scales: sequence, structure, atoms in motion, cells and tissue.

chunks.text: Biology has a ladder of scales: sequence, structure, atoms in motion, cells and tissue.

sentences.cap: Machine learning now has a ladder alongside it, mostly open-weight, mostly new.

chunks.text: Machine learning now has a ladder alongside it, mostly open-weight, mostly new.

sentences.cap: Each rung swaps an expensive physical calculation for a learned one, and the catch is trust.

chunks.text: Each rung swaps an expensive physical calculation for a learned one, and the catch is trust.

sentences.cap: In two days in Auckland, we climbed two rungs.

chunks.text: In two days in Auckland, we climbed two rungs.

sentences.cap: Docking a billion molecules takes about a hundred days.

chunks.text: Docking a billion molecules takes about a hundred days.

sentences.cap: So you train a surrogate on docking scores, and dock only what it ranks highest.

chunks.text: So you train a surrogate on docking scores, and dock only what it ranks highest.

sentences.cap: We rebuilt that surrogate: VDSAI Lightning, an AttentiveFP graph network replacing AMPL's GraphConv stack.

chunks.text: We rebuilt that surrogate: VDSAI Lightning, an AttentiveFP graph network replacing AMPL's GraphConv stack.

sentences.cap: It trained 13× faster, and after tuning it beat AMPL on every test metric.

chunks.text: It trained 13× faster, and after tuning it beat AMPL on every test metric.

sentences.cap: Then we scored 925 million molecules in under four and a half hours on a single workspace.

chunks.text: Then we scored 925 million molecules in under four and a half hours on a single workspace.

sentences.cap: Head to head, Lightning recovered 35% of the true docking top million. AMPL recovered 32%, ranking by size 2.6%, random picks 1.2%.

chunks.text: Head to head, Lightning recovered 35% of the true docking top million.
AMPL recovered 32%, ranking by size 2.6%, random picks 1.2%.

sentences.cap: And it used 381× fewer GPU hours.

chunks.text: And it used 381× fewer GPU hours.

sentences.cap: Two dockings of the same molecules correlate at only 0.3, so the surrogate is now chasing a noisy target.

chunks.text: Two dockings of the same molecules correlate at only 0.3, so the surrogate is now chasing a noisy target.

sentences.cap: Rung two carries a molecular signal all the way up to physiology.

chunks.text: Rung two carries a molecular signal all the way up to physiology.

sentences.cap: Our pipeline turns a molecular dynamics trajectory into a model that a heart or kidney cell model can run.

chunks.text: Our pipeline turns a molecular dynamics trajectory into a model that a heart or kidney cell model can run.

sentences.cap: It measures diffusion, learns the free-energy landscape, finds the barriers, and builds a bond graph, written out as standard CellML.

chunks.text: It measures diffusion, learns the free-energy landscape, finds the barriers,
and builds a bond graph, written out as standard CellML.

sentences.cap: The physics is in the architecture: the second law holds for any weights, at any point in training.

chunks.text: The physics is in the architecture: the second law holds for any weights, at any point in training.

sentences.cap: An unconstrained network fits just as well, and breaks thermodynamics. Ours cannot make current from nothing.

chunks.text: An unconstrained network fits just as well, and breaks thermodynamics. Ours cannot make current from nothing.

sentences.cap: On the KcsA potassium channel, with geometry from its crystal structure, the model gives a reversal potential of −91.3 mV.

chunks.text: On the KcsA potassium channel, with geometry from its crystal structure,
the model gives a reversal potential of −91.3 mV.

sentences.cap: That's the Nernst value, to numerical precision, across a hundred-fold range of potassium: the check a broken model fails.

chunks.text: That's the Nernst value, to numerical precision,
across a hundred-fold range of potassium: the check a broken model fails.

sentences.cap: Every number records where it came from, and a mutation audit breaks the code on purpose to prove the tests notice.

chunks.text: Every number records where it came from, and a mutation audit breaks the code on purpose to prove the tests notice.

sentences.cap: We report what didn't work, too.

chunks.text: We report what didn't work, too.

sentences.cap: The KcsA landscape is constrained to published values, not yet learned, and conductance comes out more than twenty times too low.

chunks.text: The KcsA landscape is constrained to published values, not yet learned,
and conductance comes out more than twenty times too low.

sentences.cap: Potassium crosses KcsA by multi-ion knock-on, and our model is single-ion. So we've moved to gramicidin A, where one ion is the right model.

chunks.text: Potassium crosses KcsA by multi-ion knock-on, and our model is single-ion.
So we've moved to gramicidin A, where one ion is the right model.

sentences.cap: So how far can a chain of surrogates take us? Further than we expected, if every link carries its own evidence.

chunks.text: So how far can a chain of surrogates take us? Further than we expected, if every link carries its own evidence.

sentences.cap: Lightning makes billion-molecule screening an afternoon's work. The bond-graph pipeline turns atoms into a component physiologists can use.
